logp.method_description: The lipophilicity value for the molecules was determined in terms of log Po/w (partition coefficient between n-octanol and water), involving the flask-shaking technique [36]. By taking 0.0023 g of the complex into 10 mL of octanol-water mixture (1:1 v/v) at room temperature. After allowing the solution to stand, the two phases (aqueous and octanol) became separated, and the complex concentration in both the phases was calculated through Beer–Lambert law. With these concentrations, the lipophilicity value of the complex was achieved using the log Po/w = log ([complex] octanol phase/[complex] water phase) equation.
